ceu: ✦ The conjunction between the Sun and Pluto

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.

The Sun and Pluto are together in {S:10}: willpower and visibility, depth and transformation, all focused on friends and plans for the future. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Drink a glass of water as soon as you wake up.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.
The Sun and Pluto are together in {S:10}: willpower and visibility, depth and transformation, all focused on your career and your goals. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Play with a child or remember what it was like to play.

t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
The Sun and Pluto are together in {S:10}: willpower and visibility, depth and transformation, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Have dinner without the television and talk with the people you live with.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.
The Sun and Pluto are together in {S:10}: willpower and visibility, depth and transformation, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Ask the question you are embarrassed to ask: the answer may surprise you.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.
The Sun and Pluto are together in {S:10}: willpower and visibility, depth and transformation, all focused on relationships and partnerships. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Before buying, wait twenty-four hours and see if you still want it.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.
The Sun and Pluto are together in {S:10}: willpower and visibility, depth and transformation, all focused on routine, daily work and health. A new beginning may be born from here.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Write down three of your qualities and read them out loud.

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.
The Sun and Pluto are together in {S:10}: willpower and visibility, depth and transformation, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. This is where your strength lies today.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Light some incense or a candle and breathe deeply.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.
The Sun and Pluto are together in {S:10}: willpower and visibility, depth and transformation, all focused on home and family. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Send a message to a friend you miss.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.

The Sun and Pluto are together in {S:10}: willpower and visibility, depth and transformation, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Update your CV or your professional profile.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.
The Sun and Pluto are together in {S:10}: willpower and visibility, depth and transformation, all focused on your money and what you value. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Plan a little getaway, even if it is only for next month.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.
The Sun and Pluto are together in {S:10}: willpower and visibility, depth and transformation, all focused on your image and your personal energy. It is a good day to start something in this area.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Let someone help you: receiving is also a virtue.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.
The Sun and Pluto are together in {S:10}: willpower and visibility, depth and transformation, all focused on rest and your inner life. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Listen to the end before you answer.
